comment: Independent polyself.c set_uasmon() witness for its status_initialize(REASSESS_ONLY) call. A debug Samurai with the wintty.c BL_CAP blank of status-capacity-blank (here created at T:1) polymorphs into a dwarf with #polyself. The reassessment sets gu.update_all, so botl.c resends every field: BL_CAP drops the blank, and BL_HP is sent with chg 0, so hilite_status:hitpoints/down/red does not colour the lower dwarf hit points.
